title: Upgrade 0.8.0 note: ticket create can reuse the id of a running task
body: What happened: the 0.8.0 note for adding create to a file ticket tool says to pick one more than the highest number in use. A running task (PG-333) had a branch and worktree but no ticket file, so the highest ticket file was PG-332 and a naive create would hand out PG-333 again. Expected: the note tells tool authors to also count ids used by task branches, worktrees or active runs. Steps: have a run started with --text (no ticket file), then call create on a file tool that only scans the backlog folder. Evidence: warden upgrade --notes step 5, wording 'one more than the highest number in use'. I made our tool also scan local branch names; it then correctly returned PG-334.
